english.dashboard.importReport.metadataQueuePaci: Channel metadata queue: {count} imported rows pending. The background worker performs one serialized lookup at a randomized 7–15 second interval while awake. A failed row retries after about 2 minutes, then backs off up to 30 minutes; that retry never pauses fresh rows. Permanent not-found or terminated rows stop retrying and remain in Import Reports for manual verification. No burst of requests was made during import. Closing this dashboard does not stop the queue, although browser shutdown or wakeup limits can delay it.
